visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Left-aligned 96px uppercase block confined to the right half, one accent word, clear of the left object field.

visualNarrative.action: In the left field a faint dial ring draws itself around a center point, its rim studded with small dim tick-arrows all pointing different ways.
visualNarrative.meaning: Everyone's asks: many directions offered, none of them yours.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One muted circular ring at x=30%, several small dim arrowheads on its rim, no gold anywhere yet.

visualNarrative.action: The ring begins to rotate; as each tick-arrow passes the top, a short label flickers ('MATCH', 'CHANGE', 'PLEASE') and the rim arrows pulse like applause marks.
visualNarrative.meaning: The audience keeps re-asking and applauding for a reshaped answer.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Rotating ring with dim arc-pulses on the rim, three muted 34px labels swapping in sequence, all secondary grey.

visualNarrative.action: A single gold bearing needle snaps outward from the center on one fixed heading, locking there while the ring keeps turning behind it.
visualNarrative.meaning: You choose one direction — and it does not turn with the room.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One straight gold needle from dial center to a fixed bearing, ring visibly mid-rotation behind it, gold restricted to needle and one heading tick.

visualNarrative.action: The ring accelerates a full turn, arrows and applause pulses sweep past the needle; the needle never deflects by a frame, and the label 'ONE BEARING' fades in at its tip.
visualNarrative.meaning: Confirmation: pressure is cyclical, the stance is not — everyone keeps clapping, you keep your heading.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Needle pixel-identical through the sweep, one 34px muted label at the needle tip, no second accent color.

visualNarrative.action: Ring, arrows and applause pulses dissolve; a soft restrained glow settles along the needle, the caption fades in bottom-right, and the frame holds perfectly static.
visualNarrative.meaning: Resolve: once the noise is gone, only your direction remains in the frame.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Single gold needle on an empty dark field, one complete caption on its own baseline, absolute stillness.
